reviewer: parent agent; manual semantic review, not independent

semantic_checks.criterion: 实际隐式加载安装版Money Craft和相关引用；路由有效，身份及历史回放限制清晰
semantic_checks.reason: Installed Skill and relevant references observed in command trace, route READY; identity, dates and extraction limitations explicit.

semantic_checks.criterion: 不把市场现货价格机械等同公司合同实现价或收入弹性；无价格桥时明确缺口
semantic_checks.reason: Final answer explicitly separates price contribution from spot decline and identifies contract repricing lag, product/region/customer mix gaps; no industry-price profit elasticity invented.

semantic_checks.criterion: 区分分部与集团以及调整后EBITDA与GAAP利润；收入比率不当价格beta或单位经济性
semantic_checks.reason: Separate segment revenue, group adjusted EBITDA, GAAP operating profit and common-share loss after preferred dividends.

semantic_checks.criterion: 识别Q4负利润基数及LCM减记，避免负基数百分比增长误导
semantic_checks.reason: Prior-year LCM charge identified, no negative-base growth percentage. Tax benefit belongs to net-income explanation; wording can be more precise about which profit improves.

semantic_checks.criterion: 从现金流原表计算OCF减资本支出，识别客户预付款和削减资本支出的影响；不当可持续或可分配现金
semantic_checks.reason: OCF minus capex and prepayment diagnostic computed; no distributable-cash or sustainable-cash claim. Input precision caveat remains useful for the rounded prepayment disclosure.

semantic_checks.criterion: 不按分部收入占比分配集团现金流；同发行人多份披露不当独立双源
semantic_checks.reason: No segment allocation of group cash; same issuer not independent corroboration; dividend prose/table conflict disclosed.

semantic_checks.criterion: 下一复查有报告期或披露事件窗口及判断变动条件；不编造发布日期，不形成买卖结论
semantic_checks.reason: Q2/half-year reporting window and strengthening/weakening conditions explicit; no invented release date or trading conclusion.

comparison.scope: Single observed before/after pair; not proof of causality or stable generalization.

limits: Historical timeout and PARTIAL receipts remain unchanged.
No new source capture, independent financial corroboration, valuation or application acceptance.
PASS applies to saved seven criteria for this bounded task; not all investment research quality.
editorial_notes: Prepayment-adjusted residual uses a rounded input and is approximate.
Discrete tax benefit supports net-income attribution, not operating margin or EBITDA attribution.
